host_relevance: Microbiota-derived indole-3-propionate supports intestinal barrier and anti-inflammatory signaling
microbial_evidence: Lactobacillus reuteri I5007 produces indole-3-lactate, and its cell-free supernatant or indole-3-lactate increased indole-3-propionate production by Clostridium sporogenes ATCC 15579
selection_rationale: Exact-strain literature-positive validation of an indole-3-lactate-to-indole-3-propionate cross-feeding route
